selected.source_text: PubMed abstract only (no full text available) plus GEO series summary/overall design and the authors' deposited DESeq2 table GSE221894_PostLean-PreLean_rawDE-v2.xls.gz
selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq, vastus lateralis biopsy, Illumina NextSeq 2000 100bp SE, salmon v1.4.0 (GEO data_processing)
selected.sample_inclusion: 15 sedentary normal-weight adults started, 14 completed 7 HIIT sessions over 14 days; biopsies before and 48 h after the last session (abstract)
selected.primary_estimand: within-person change in vastus lateralis gene expression from before to 48 h after 2 weeks (7 sessions) of HIIT
selected.repeated_measure_unit: participant (pre and post biopsy from the same person)
planned_contrasts: post-HIIT vs pre-HIIT (abstract: transcripts that increased/decreased with HIIT; GEO deposited table PostLean-PreLean)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.32.0 on salmon quantifications (GEO data_processing); exact design formula (paired or not) not stated in the abstract
selected.paper_results: abstract: increased transcripts enriched for mitochondrial respiration gene sets (especially complex I); decreased transcripts enriched for DNA and chromatin remodelling pathways; no DEG count given. Deposited authors' table: 35 genes padj<0.05 (19 up, 16 down) among 5944 genes listed (all baseMean>140).

decisions.reason: No full text; the abstract defines the estimand (pre vs 48 h post 2-wk HIIT in the same people) and the qualitative pathway result. GEO data_processing names salmon v1.4.0 + DESeq2 v1.32.0. The GEO supplementary DE table (Post-Pre) gives the authors' own gene-level result and is used as the count comparison.

checks: series title equals the paper title
27 GSM quant.sf files in GSE221894_RAW.tar, one per GSM of the series
matrix built from that tar by prep_salmon_to_gene.py

decisions.reason: GSE221894 is linked to PMID 36603044 in GEO and has the paper's title; the matrix is derived only from this series' per-sample salmon files.

Matrix columns are GSM ids = metadata index (27/27 exact). Titles follow <participant><a|b>; a = baseline and b = 48 h post for 26/27 samples per the status field. Time is taken from the title: GSM6909087 '7b' is annotated 'baseline' but its title says b; with 7b as post there are exactly 14 post biopsies = the 14 completers in the abstract, and 13 complete pre samples + 1 non-completer. This is treated as a GEO labelling error and fixed (sensitivity run excludes participant 7). Unpaired samples: 27a (likely the non-completer), 4b and 8b (no baseline deposited).

Salmon v1.4.0 NumReads (estimated counts, 87% integer-valued, max 1.6e6) summed per Ensembl gene (tximport-style, Ensembl 104 tx2gene; ~1.4% reads on transcripts absent from Ens104). The paper used DESeq2 on salmon output, so rounded estimated counts into DESeq2 matches the paper's input.

Abstract: biopsies before and 48 h after HIIT in the same participants; the estimand is the within-person training effect. Single two-level time factor with participant as the blocking unit; samples without a partner do not inform a subject-blocked contrast and are dropped by complete_pairs. Both sexes are present; per-sex paired analyses are added as exploratory.

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: absorbed by subject blocking (constant within participant); per-sex exploratory runs instead

decisions.reason: Repeated measures within participant -> subject is a blocking term (~ subject + time). Sex does not vary within a participant so it is aliased with subject and not added.

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald) ~ subject + time on rounded salmon gene-level estimated counts

paper_route.reason: same model family; abstract does not state whether the authors blocked on participant; pydeseq2 instead of R DESeq2; tximport length offsets not used

deviations: participant blocking chosen from the study design (paper formula unknown)
gene summarisation by summed NumReads without tximport average-length offsets

decisions.reason: DESeq2 on rounded estimated counts reproduces the paper's DESeq2-on-salmon route; subject blocking matches the paired design. An unpaired all-sample ~ time model is run as exploratory to compare with the authors' deposited table, which may have been unpaired.

selected.deviation_note: Abstract gives no DEG threshold; BH padj < 0.05 without fold-change cutoff (workflow default). Raw p < 0.05 shown only as a labelled audit count (authors' table: 788 at p<0.05).

decisions.reason: No threshold in the available text.
paired DESeq2 on the 12 complete participants (including 7 with 7b as post)
drops participant 7 whose post label was corrected
all 27 samples, ~ time, as the authors may have fitted; for comparison with the deposited table

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the PubMed abstract and GEO-deposited files only (no full text).
Participant 7's post sample (GSM6909087, title 7b) is annotated 'baseline' in GEO; relabelled as post from the title (sensitivity run excludes participant 7).
Authors' deposited table lists only 5944 genes (baseMean>140); its 35 padj<0.05 genes are the count reference, but its gene filtering and design are unknown.
Per-sex analyses are exploratory (5 male pairs).

decisions.reason: Planned route is DESeq2 like the paper but with declared deviations (blocking chosen by us, gene summarisation). paper_counts are from the authors' GEO-deposited DESeq2 table at padj<0.05 (19 up incl. COQ10A, MDH1, ALAS1, BCKDK, CHCHD3; 16 down incl. MSTN, PFKFB3, USP6), not from the abstract.
